root_causes: The prior membership audit and derivation substituted physical row ordinals for CPVS Table2 Seq / lightcurve SourceID.

The earlier flag-zero and magnitude-cut diagnostics do not reproduce the published set and must not be adopted as arbitrary cardinality tuning.

findings: A catalog membership audit is valid only when both sets use the publisher-defined identifier key.
The current Seq-based audit has zero duplicate or unmapped published names, but that alone does not prove exact scientific reproduction.
A set containing every published object but 11602 extras indicates unresolved selection semantics, not a fully reproduced benchmark.
Flag-zero and magnitude-cut variants fail independent membership comparison and cannot be accepted merely because they change candidate cardinality.
NaN comparisons are false; threshold guards must explicitly reject non-finite SNR values.
